elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The clause contains a materials-and-workmanship warranty for Software media, but no professional-and-workmanlike performance warranty for Services.

elements.element: The Software conforms in substantial accordance with the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: Commerce One expressly warrants that the Software will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation.

elements.element: Any non-Software deliverables conform to the applicable Documentation.
elements.evidence: The clause covers only the Software and MarketSite.net Service; it does not expressly cover other deliverables, and their absence is not demonstrated.

elements.element: The Software documentation-conformance warranty lasts at least twelve months.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a twelve-month Warranty Period beginning upon Corio's acceptance of the Software.

elements.element: The applicable warranty for Services lasts at least ninety days.
elements.evidence: The MarketSite.net Service is included in the same twelve-month Warranty Period, which exceeds ninety days.

elements.element: Repair or correction is available as a remedy for covered nonconformance.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must use all commercially reasonable efforts to correct documentation nonconformance during the Warranty Period.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy if correction is not reasonably possible.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must replace the Software and MarketSite.net Service free of charge if correction is reasonably not possible, and must replace defective media returned during the Warranty Period.

elements.element: A refund is available if the covered breach cannot reasonably be corrected.
elements.evidence: Corio may terminate and receive a refund of all prepaid fees if the breach cannot reasonably be corrected at Commerce One's expense.

elements.element: Commerce One complies with applicable laws in performing the Services and providing the Software or deliverables.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause contains no compliance-with-laws warranty.

elements.element: The Software, deliverables, and Services contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: The warranty is limited to malicious code that was willfully introduced and applies only during the Warranty Period; it does not provide the unqualified no-malicious-code warranty required by the preferred position.

elements.element: The Software warranty lasts at least ninety days.
elements.evidence: The Software warranty lasts twelve months from acceptance, exceeding the ninety-day fallback.

elements.element: The Services warranty lasts at least thirty days.
elements.evidence: The MarketSite.net Service is covered by the same twelve-month Warranty Period, exceeding the thirty-day fallback.

elements.element: Repair or correction is available as a remedy for covered nonconformance.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must use all commercially reasonable efforts to correct covered documentation nonconformance.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy if correction is not reasonably possible.
elements.evidence: The clause requires free replacement where correction is reasonably not possible and separately requires replacement of defective media.

elements.element: A refund is available if the covered breach cannot reasonably be corrected.
elements.evidence: Corio may terminate and receive a refund of all prepaid fees when the breach cannot reasonably be corrected.

result.reason: The redline exceeds the fallback and meets the preferred twelve-month Software duration, while retaining repair/correction, replacement, and refund remedies. It does not satisfy the complete preferred position because it omits a professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty, coverage for other deliverables, and a compliance-with-laws warranty, and its malicious-code warranty is limited to willfully introduced code. It is not minimal because the single twelve-month period also extends the MarketSite.net Service warranty well beyond both the preferred ninety-day and fallback thirty-day service periods; separate Software and Services periods would be more precise.
